title: A first change is asked only for implementation coverage
statement: The first time someone tries Change Saga on a pull request, the one thing asked is that the implementation covers it; the first run is initialize, cover the change, done.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Every changed line of a first change is referenced by the implementation deck; personas, stories, design, and test cases are not asked for up front.
The first run is: initialize, cover the change, done; after that the authoring agent offers, and never requires, to capture the stories the change implies.
The first change's deck goes into a feature the author names, with a default; story, deck, and slide URNs carry no feature, so reorganizing later breaks nothing.
